one_line: SMB accounting platform with the very broad QuickBooks Online Accounting REST API covering invoices, payments, customers, items, bills, and reports.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 with scopes via the Intuit developer portal; app registration (self-serve) yields client key/secret. Sandbox/test company is free; production access requires an active QuickBooks subscription and app approval.
self_serve_notes: Developer sandbox and app registration are free and self-serve; real accounting data requires a QuickBooks Online subscription (free trial then paid) and Intuit app approval for production.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Hundreds of endpoints across QuickBooks Online Accounting (customers, invoices, payments, bills, items, journal entries, reports), plus Payments, eCommerce, Payroll, and 3rd-party APIs.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks supported — subscribe to entity events (invoice, payment, etc.) with signed payloads.

existing_mcp.note: Community MCP servers for QuickBooks exist; no official MCP published by Intuit.

evidence.note: No fetched text file existed for this app; facts from domain knowledge of the Intuit developer platform and QuickBooks Online Accounting API.

agent_notes: Sandbox is buildable quickly; production requires QuickBooks subscription + app approval — hence buildable_with_work.
